patch.summary: Enable or disable a project, lock or unlock it

400.description: Fields other than enabled and locked, or one not a boolean

409.description: The project is not locked, or has tasks in flight (their ids are in details)

patch.description: Setting only locked is always allowed. Any other change needs the project locked and drained: no task in flight, that is PENDING, QUEUED or RUNNING, SUCCESS with no result yet, or with a result IN_PROGRESS. While locked, ingest and evaluation skip the project and API tasks are rejected with 409.

delete.summary: Delete a project and everything under it
delete.description: Hard delete of the project and its tasks, requests, datasets (and their Keycloak entries), trigger and results repositories and secrets, including the stored secret values. Needs the project locked and drained, see PATCH.

409.description: The project is not locked, or has tasks in flight (their ids are in details)

get.summary: Check the project's trigger repositories can be reached
get.description: Reads each repository's token from its cluster secret and calls the git provider's API with it. A failed check is reported in the body, with a 200.

get.summary: List the project's secrets
get.description: The secret values are never returned. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

post.description: Writes the values to the secret store and records a reference to them. The secret is stored under the generated key "<project_id>-<label>", which never changes. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

400.description: label missing or not a valid Kubernetes name, provider not a known provider, or values is missing, empty or not an object, a key is not letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.', or a value is not a non-empty string

409.description: A secret with this label already exists in the project

get.summary: Get a secret
get.description: The secret values are never returned. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The secret's label, local to the project

patch.description: Writes the given keys to the stored secret, e.g. to rotate a token. Every repository or dataset that references the secret picks the new values up. Keys not in the request are left as they are. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The secret's label, local to the project

400.description: Values is missing, empty or not an object, a key is not letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.', or a value is not a non-empty string, or the secret store could not be written

delete.description: Deletes the reference and the stored secret. Refused while a trigger repository, results repository or dataset still uses it. Requires the can_admin_dataset scope.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The secret's label, local to the project

400.description: The secret could not be removed from the secret store

409.description: The secret is still used by a repository or dataset
